recommended_client_flow: GET api/v1/manifest.json only when version changes
GET the recommended core-data .json.gz once and cache it locally
Download images only on demand and cache by sha256
Use release/offline image bundles only for explicit bulk installation
strategy.pages_note: GitHub Pages serves selected optimized runtime images on demand. Fullbody/skin release ZIPs are generated only when explicitly requested, so normal Import/Pages builds do not duplicate the heavy image payload.
